# Browser Automation with agent-browser

## Quick start

```bash
agent-browser open <url>        # Navigate to page
agent-browser snapshot -i       # Get interactive elements with refs
agent-browser click @e1         # Click element by ref
agent-browser fill @e2 "text"   # Fill input by ref
agent-browser close             # Close browser
```

## Core workflow

1. Navigate: `agent-browser open <url>`
2. Snapshot: `agent-browser snapshot -i` (returns elements with refs like `@e1`, `@e2`)
3. Interact using refs from the snapshot
4. Re-snapshot after navigation or significant DOM changes

## Commands

### Navigation

```bash
agent-browser open <url>      # Navigate to URL
agent-browser back            # Go back
agent-browser forward         # Go forward
agent-browser reload          # Reload page
agent-browser close           # Close browser
```

### Snapshot (page analysis)

```bash
agent-browser snapshot            # Full accessibility tree
agent-browser snapshot -i         # Interactive elements only (recommended)
agent-browser snapshot -c         # Compact output
agent-browser snapshot -d 3       # Limit depth to 3
agent-browser snapshot -s "#main" # Scope to CSS selector
```

### Interactions (use @refs from snapshot)

```bash
agent-browser click @e1           # Click
agent-browser dblclick @e1        # Double-click
agent-browser fill @e2 "text"     # Clear and type
agent-browser type @e2 "text"     # Type without clearing
agent-browser press Enter         # Press key
agent-browser hover @e1           # Hover
agent-browser check @e1           # Check checkbox
agent-browser uncheck @e1         # Uncheck checkbox
agent-browser select @e1 "value"  # Select dropdown option
agent-browser scroll down 500     # Scroll page
agent-browser upload @e1 file.pdf # Upload files
```

### Get information

```bash
agent-browser get text @e1        # Get element text
agent-browser get html @e1        # Get innerHTML
agent-browser get value @e1       # Get input value
agent-browser get attr @e1 href   # Get attribute
agent-browser get title           # Get page title
agent-browser get url             # Get current URL
agent-browser get count ".item"   # Count matching elements
```

### Screenshots & PDF

```bash
agent-browser screenshot          # Save to temp directory
agent-browser screenshot path.png # Save to specific path
agent-browser screenshot --full   # Full page
agent-browser pdf output.pdf      # Save as PDF
```

### Wait

```bash
agent-browser wait @e1                     # Wait for element
agent-browser wait 2000                    # Wait milliseconds
agent-browser wait --text "Success"        # Wait for text
agent-browser wait --url "**/dashboard"    # Wait for URL pattern
agent-browser wait --load networkidle      # Wait for network idle
```

### Semantic locators (alternative to refs)

```bash
agent-browser find role button click --name "Submit"
agent-browser find text "Sign In" click
agent-browser find label "Email" fill "user@test.com"
agent-browser find placeholder "Search" type "query"
```

### Authentication with saved state

```bash
# Login once
agent-browser open https://app.example.com/login
agent-browser snapshot -i
agent-browser fill @e1 "username"
agent-browser fill @e2 "password"
agent-browser click @e3
agent-browser wait --url "**/dashboard"
agent-browser state save auth.json

# Later: load saved state
agent-browser state load auth.json
agent-browser open https://app.example.com/dashboard
```

### Cookies & Storage

```bash
agent-browser cookies                     # Get all cookies
agent-browser cookies set name value      # Set cookie
agent-browser cookies clear               # Clear cookies
agent-browser storage local               # Get localStorage
agent-browser storage local set k v       # Set value
```

### JavaScript

```bash
agent-browser eval "document.title"   # Run JavaScript
```

## Example: Form submission

```bash
agent-browser open https://example.com/form
agent-browser snapshot -i
# Output shows: textbox "Email" [ref=e1], textbox "Password" [ref=e2], button "Submit" [ref=e3]

agent-browser fill @e1 "user@example.com"
agent-browser fill @e2 "password123"
agent-browser click @e3
agent-browser wait --load networkidle
agent-browser snapshot -i  # Check result
```

## Example: Data extraction

```bash
agent-browser open https://example.com/products
agent-browser snapshot -i
agent-browser get text @e1  # Get product title
agent-browser get attr @e2 href  # Get link URL
agent-browser screenshot products.png
```

--BODY--
[p] Supply Chain & Efficiency
[p] The future of mobility
[p] Creating a future-ready workforce
[h1] People and Organisation
[p] Share Copy Link Link Copied Close The world of work is changing-fast. The pressure to optimise costs and maximise productivity is always there. Today, it’s made more complicated by disruptive technology, the increasing complexity of geopolitics, the constant tests of risk and regulation, and the ongoing race to find and keep the right talent with the right skills. These forces are reshaping the workplace and introducing new challenges that impact your whole organisation.
[p] Making sure your workforce is ready for these uncertain times is essential to building trust in the marketplace. PwC’s community of solvers combines the breadth of strategic knowledge and hands-on implementation experience to help your business - and your people - adjust to change and thrive in an unpredictable world.
[p] Eyhab Abdeen Middle East People & Organisation Leader
[p] to build a digitally-enabled, best-in-class HR function
[p] to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of your people
[p] undergoing a change – strategic, organisational or operational
[p] to build a ‘world class’ organisation and remain abreast of external trends and benchmarks
[h2] We can help you transform your people and organisation, improve productivity and performance, and drive business growth through:
[p] Shaping the future workforce and enabling talent is a priority for all organisations across all sectors, where achieving the right formulation of sizing, capabilities, shape, cost, and distribution is critical for organisational results and the future.
[p] Our workforce strategies take evidence-based insights yielded through strategic workforce planning and analysis to identify initiatives and activities aimed at mitigating a potential workforce risk, addressing a talent gap, or drive a workforce priority to secure a future-fit workforce.
[p] Using our in house developed Talent Forecast Tool, we help you align business and talent strategy, model projected demand against talent supply, and create plans to lessen gaps under a continual improvement approach.
[p] Upskilling and talent development for a future-proof workforce is more important than ever.
[p] Where having effective talent development programs in place is not a luxury, but rather a business imperative, establishing such programs is a multi-stage process that combines effective assessment techniques with the right frameworks and capabilities.
[p] Our workforce development and capability assessment frameworks help determine current and future workforce capabilities the business needs, identify skills gaps and mismatches and workforce development opportunities and upskilling options.
[p] We help you create workforce and leadership competencies models, build and administer fit-for-purpose assessment centres and establish and implement talent and leadership development programs, in addition to workforce upskilling and reskilling programs.
[p] Learn more about our Workforce Upskilling models.
[h3] Workforce Experience & Performance
[p] Attracting, engaging, unlocking talent potential and performance is not a coincidence, but a result of careful understanding, planning, and execution of well-thought strategy to create a seamless workforce experience. Shaping, delivering and sustaining such an experience is a result of finding the right balance between the organisational culture, strategy, and what attracts, motivates, and engages talent to drive the right behaviours and performance.
[p] We help you shape your employer value proposition (EVP), improve employee experience (EX), and integrate these strategies with proven performance management frameworks that maximise the contribution of individuals and teams to the performance and culture of the organisation.
[p] The strength of workforce experience & performance solutions is in our ability to integrate into a single solution that is backed-up by our access to global databases and benchmarking platforms in addition to methodologies and unique approaches.
[h3] Organisational Design
[p] Organisational design should be approached in a holistic manner that extends beyond shaping organisational structures and defining roles and responsibilities.
[p] We understand that an effective organisational design consists of a group of interrelated elements that need to be integrated and aligned with organisational strategy and mandate to achieve the targeted objectives and drive the aspired results.
[p] We help you reimagine your operating models, design your organisational structures and define your operational governance while embedding ESG principles and new ways of working to help you cope with the unprecedented times of organisational transition.
[p] More than ever, organisations are being challenged to meet the talent demands to support their business growth. Investing in your employees is one of the most effective ways to attract and retain top talent.
[p] We help you understand your people’s compensation and benefits needs; supporting you from the design to implementation of cost-efficient compensation and benefit plans, that are designed to support the attraction, engagement and retention of key talent, help drive individual and collective discretionary effort, and align reward, performance and business strategy.
[h3] Communication & Change Management
[p] Change management is the process of planning and implementing approved changes in the workplace. In order to achieve a successful transformation, it's important to have an effective change framework and strategy that communicates to all employees how, when and why a new way of working has been adopted.
[p] Our People-Centric Change approach is a unique and proven way to achieve your strategy by driving positive, sustainable change through your people.
[p] We have a tailored approach for building internal change management capabilities within organisations – either as personal development or as permanent roles. We will co-create change strategies and plans to align, engage, enable and empower your people and reduce resistance to change.

og:title:: Workforce Transformation and Change
og:description:: In a rapidly evolving world of work, where people are the most valuable asset, organisations must adapt their business strategies to work smarter and more efficiently in managing their workforce.
description:: In a rapidly evolving world of work, where people are the most valuable asset, organisations must adapt their business strategies to work smarter and more efficiently in managing their workforce.
--BODY--
[h1] Workforce Transformation and Change
[p] Delivering the right workforce size, shape, skills, culture - and supporting leaders and people through the change
[p] The rate of innovation and change is unprecedented and almost all organisations are going through transformation. Capabilities and skills in the workforce, the employment models, the shape of the organisation, what employees expect and the culture are all transforming too. The challenge faced by companies is in understanding what this needs to look like, and building the pathway there. What is the right size, shape, skills and culture for your organisation? It often starts with workforce strategy - the current supply and future demand modelling and then the infrastructure that takes you there. Organisational leaders are critical in the success of workforce transformation. Leadership will make the difference on embedding new ways of working, as well as supporting people to enhance productivity, inclusion, innovation, and engagement.
[p] Our expertise helps organisations design solutions, work through the implications of transformation and put in place the programmes that support you and the workforce on that journey. From operating models, strategic workforce planning, organisation design, performance, leadership and culture, talent attraction and management, EVP, and change management - we work with leaders and teams to co-create a workforce and environment that is sustainable, resilient and can adapt.
[h3] People centric change approach
[p] We can work with you to deliver a strategic approach to change by understanding what’s driving the need for change, what needs to change and helping you identify a clear vision. We can collaborate with you to create a plan that enables your people to execute and embrace lasting transformation by empowering them to change their behaviour by focusing on the critical few things that drive successful results for you.
[h3] Change readiness assessment
[p] Evaluating the level of risk and readiness of your organisation can be done at anytime through our assessments; they can be used as a baseline evaluation for an upcoming project, an audit for an ongoing programme or to assess the past history of change and why it may not have been successful.
[h3] Building your internal change capacility
[p] Our internal change methodology helps you build in-house change management teams and capability over time, using three models that can work with your organisation to different degrees - Centre of Excellence, Leveraged Talent and Project Based Change.
[h3] People communications
[p] We can partner with you to embed the right people communications in the delivery model of your project, making the shift from transactional to inspirational communications. We can work with our Digital Experience team to help you define the right strategy and then translate complex, critical information into simple, user-friendly and thought-provoking imagery. These can be used to craft messages that attract attention, stimulate conversation and accelerate transformation.
[h3] Skills based organisation
[p] Partnering with organisations to assess jobs and skills architecture, leveraging generative AI to deliver organisational agility, at pace and scale to meet future demands.
[h3] Upskilling and Reskilling
[p] We work with clients to build a future-ready workforce with personalised learning journeys that use a combination of data-driven insights, human-centred design, and behavioural science, delivering relevant and impactful upskilling and reskilling opportunities.
[h3] Change engagement and adoption
[p] Delivering the right workforce size, shape, skills, culture - and supporting leaders and people through the change.
[h3] Workforce productivity and efficiency
[p] Helping organisations design and implement HR functions with the right operating model, capabilities and tools through the use of technology and Generative AI to boost the productivity of your HR function.

og:title:: Change management
og:description:: As change partner, we put people at the centre. We design change management and transformation in a holistic and measurable way.

--BODY--
[p] Back (see screen at page 12)
[p] Engineering Future Relevance – with Data & AI
[p] Putting people at the heart of transformation
[p] Your expert in case you have questions
[p] Susanne Schmutzler Partner Change Management in Workforce Transformation, PwC Germany Email LinkedIn
[p] Your environment is changing rapidly: digitalisation, new technologies, and dynamic markets are posing new challenges to businesses every day. The key to success lies in your organisation’s ability to adapt and this doesn’t start with processes or tools, but with people.
[p] We can support you in placing your employees at the centre of your transformation journey. In this way, change is not only implemented but truly lived – with a clear vision, targeted capability building, and firm integration into daily work.
[p] You know that professional change management is decisive for the success of your transformation. But you need a partner who takes responsibility – with experience, proven methodologies, and a strong network. Whether it’s a focused project or a global transformation, we will stand by you as a reliable, equal partner.
[p] Our offer: we design change holistically and in a way that fits your organisation. From well-defined change processes to company-wide transformation, our experienced team, international network, and flexible resources will support you in achieving both quick wins and sustainable impact. Our commitment: to shape change effectively, measure its impact, and implement it pragmatically.
[h3] Shaping change together
[p] Successful transformation thrives on the interplay of strategy, methodology, and trust. Our promise: we listen, we think alongside you, and we stay by your side – from the first spark to implementation that lasts.
[p] “Change only succeeds when we make it together. That is why our commitment goes beyond setting standards or applying methods – it means being a reliable partner who listens, contributes ideas, and stays put. We tread this path with you.”
[p] We look forward to working with you to make your transformation a success – for your business and your people.
[h2] Make change a competitive advantage
[p] of transformations fail due to a lack of user adoption and behavioural change.
[p] of CEOs believe their business will not be viable in ten years without a change of course.
[p] of executives cite lack of workforce acceptance of change as the greatest challenge in digital transformation.
[p] of strategic digital initiatives are not fully adopted by employees.
[h2] What is your greatest challenge? Find your answer here, with us
[p] With the implementation or migration to SAP S/4HANA, you have the opportunity to realign your company from the inside out and secure your competitiveness sustainably. At the same time, the introduction is complex and a purely technical focus will fall short. Almost every function and process in your company is affected – and therefore the daily work of your employees.
[p] We design the transition to S/4HANA in such a way that it has an impact in day-to-day business. We do this through the active involvement of employees and leaders, targeted training to sharpen roles, and communication that ensures enduring change.
[p] “Making S/4HANA a success on both the technical and human level by implementing systems while engaging people.”
[p] Your HR function today makes an exponentially growing contribution to the sustainable success of your company. We will support you in embedding your HR projects effectively into the organisation and making them successful in the long term.
[p] Whether it is the transformation of your HR function, the digitalisation of your processes with modern HR IT (cloud) solutions, or the use of innovative AI, we will accompany you in your change management journey.
[p] We unite your leadership behind the project, engage employees, and enable all target groups to truly want – and be able – to adopt new tools and ways of working. Our added value: proven best practices combined with tailor-made solutions for your organisation.
[p] “Your HR service landscape with people at the centre – digital, efficient, and a true strategic partner to the business.”
[h3] Change for Operations (SCM)
[p] Since the pandemic, your supply chain has been in the spotlight. Resilience has become the decisive factor. Process digitalisation (e.g. digital planning), global control (e.g. control tower, GPOs), and new logistics models (e.g. from 3PL to 4PL) are shaping your current reality and organisational structure.
[p] Processes are being optimised and updated. Yet fundamental questions often remain unanswered: do you have the right skills within your company? Do you have a clear talent strategy? And are you successfully guiding your employees through the transformation?
[p] We will support you in navigating this complexity and making the right decisions. Because your supply chain is only as strong as the people who shape it.
[p] “You need robust supply chains and a clear path to get there. We bring the workforce into the equation.”
[h3] (Gen)AI transformation
[p] The introduction of generative AI is not only changing technologies, but also your ways of working, decision-making processes, and corporate culture. For this transformation to succeed, you need a clear change and adoption strategy that involves people, processes, and governance equally.
[p] We can help you develop a compelling AI vision, empower your employees, and successfully embed new working models. With tailored communication and training concepts, piloting, and rollouts, GenAI will become a sustainable part of your daily work. At the same time, you can adjust roles, processes, and compliance guidelines to ensure AI is applied responsibly and productively, creating real value for your business.
[p] “Your GenAI strategy – integrating sustainably, empowering employees, and optimising processes for maximum value.”
[p] Change today is more complex and faster than ever, especially in risk and regulatory. Growing cyber threats, stricter regulatory requirements, and rising stakeholder expectations are putting you under immense pressure to change. Success is created where you not only react, but anticipate. Transformation cannot be achieved through technology or processes alone – it needs orientation, clear communication, and lived acceptance. This is exactly where our change management comes in: we embed resilience into your structures and culture, strengthen your teams’ ability to act, and turn change into a driver of your sustainable transformation.

[p] We help you solve the problems that matter most so you can act faster and move further.
[h2] Creating a future-ready workforce
[p] Your people are your most powerful catalyst for transformation. At PwC, we help you unlock their full potential to build a resilient, agile, and future-ready organisation that delivers real, sustained outcomes.
[p] Work is changing fast. Technologies like AI and automation are reshaping roles at pace. Global uncertainty—from geopolitical tension and economic volatility to climate disruption and shifting regulation—is testing even the most resilient business models. Add in supply chain fragility, inflation, and evolving trade dynamics, and the pressure on organisations to respond with agility has never been greater.
[p] Hear from PwC’s Global Workforce leaders in this short video as they discuss the challenges and opportunities organisations and workers are seeing as they plan for the future of work.
[p] At the same time, demographic shifts and hybrid work are redefining how, where, and why people work. Employee expectations around flexibility, inclusion, and purpose are rising. Meeting those expectations is no longer optional—it’s essential for business success.
[p] Today’s workforce challenges are urgent and complex. Skills gaps are widening as demand for new capabilities outpaces supply. Technological change is outstripping the pace at which people can adapt. Employees want meaningful work, empathetic leadership, and trust—and they expect workplaces that reflect their values.
[p] But where there are challenges, there’s opportunity. Organisations that reimagine the role of their workforce—and invest in it—can unlock innovation, drive growth, and build lasting competitive advantage. By putting people at the heart of transformation, businesses become more adaptable, resilient, and future-ready.
[p] PwC brings together expertise in workforce strategy, technology, and human behaviour to help you navigate this shift with confidence. We work with you to align your people strategy with your business goals, reshape the employee experience, and transform HR into a strategic partner.
[p] We help you close capability gaps through large-scale upskilling and build inclusive, equitable work environments where everyone can thrive. Our approach blends insight, behavioural science, and co-creation—so the results stick, and scale.
[h2] Strategic planning for the future of work
[p] Culture, history, and leadership style. While they may be different for every organisation, changing times and new expectations are common for everyone. Whether you want to improve the performance of your workforce , develop and redeploy talent around your business, or mitigate the risks of mergers and acquisitions , we provide the advice and support you need. [h2] Explore the breadth and depth of our capabilities

[p] This means you get a community of professionals with the right skills and breadth of experience wherever you need us around the world.
[p] To hear more from our professionals, visit our Workforce of the Future YouTube playlist .
[h3] Reimagine the power of your people
[p] Learn more about how PwC can help you empower your workforce.
[h3] 5 steps to redesign roles and build trust in the AI era
[p] Agentic AI shouldn't be seen as a threat - but as a catalyst to reshape roles, upskill talent and unlock more meaningful human contribution.
[p] Our second Global AI Jobs Barometer builds on last year’s to uncover the speed at which life is changing for both workers and businesses.

## Narrative / story frame
The central move is a **deliberate rejection of "traditional change management"** in favor of an outcome-based, human-centered, adoption-obsessed frame. AI is positioned as the urgency driver, and "your people" as the mechanism of transformation.

The most striking verbatim positioning:

- **"We don't do change management. We put organizations in motion."** (US)
- **"Human-centered. Results-driven."** (US hero)
- **"Change is accelerating: driven by AI, new ways of working and evolving roles. Yet too often, change management focuses on timelines instead of adoption and impact. Our outcome-based, human-centered approach uses data, digital tools and immersive experiences to drive engagement and deliver lasting results."** (US)
- **"Whether supporting a technology implementation or enterprise transformation, we help turn change into lasting business value."** (US)
- **"NextGen Change is PwC's human-centered approach to helping you with transformation, moving beyond traditional change management to deliver lasting impact."**
- The three NextGen Change pillars, verbatim: **"Leader & Citizen Activation, Personalized Experiences, and Essential Skills & Behaviors – so you can capture the hearts and minds of your workforce and drive measurable success."**
- **"Our People-Centric Change approach is a unique and proven way to achieve your strategy by driving positive, sustainable change through your people."** (Middle East)
- **"Your people are your most powerful catalyst for transformation."** (global)
- **"By putting people at the heart of transformation, businesses become more adaptable, resilient, and future-ready."** (global)
- **"Putting people at the heart of transformation"** (Germany headline) and **"the key to success lies in your organisation's ability to adapt and this doesn't start with processes or tools, but with people."**
- **"Make change a competitive advantage"** (Germany) — supported by a fear-based stat framing: **"[XX]% of transformations fail due to a lack of user adoption and behavioural change."**
- **"Change only succeeds when we make it together… being a reliable partner who listens, contributes ideas, and stays put. We tread this path with you."** (Germany, the "partner who takes responsibility" angle)
- UK sub-headline: **"Delivering the right workforce size, shape, skills, culture - and supporting leaders and people through the change."**

Emotional/strategic angle: **AI-driven urgency → fear of failed adoption → reassurance that a human-centered partner turns change into measurable business value.** The story consistently reframes change from a project-management timeline problem into a *behavioral/adoption* problem, then sells adoption as the differentiator ("we don't do change management… we put organizations in motion").

## Who is the buyer (inferred from copy)
- **CHRO / HR leadership** is the primary buyer — the practice lives under "Organizational and HR effectiveness," heavily references "transform HR into a strategic partner," HR function transformation, and EVP. The US contact form even lists "Human Resources" and "Transformation" as job functions.
- **Transformation leaders / program owners** — copy repeatedly anchors to "technology implementation or enterprise transformation," S/4HANA and GenAI rollouts (Germany), signaling the buyer owns a large tech/transformation program at risk of low adoption.
- **CEO** as the fear-lever / economic-buyer: Germany cites **"[XX]% of CEOs believe their business will not be viable in ten years without a change of course,"** and the global page targets the C-suite via "align your people strategy with your business goals."
- **Organizational leaders / senior leadership** explicitly: UK — **"Organisational leaders are critical in the success of workforce transformation. Leadership will make the difference on embedding new ways of working."**

## Dominant recurring words / phrases
- **people** ("through your people," "putting people at the heart of," "people-centric," "people are your most powerful catalyst")
- **human-centered / human-centred** (the signature descriptor, US + global)
- **adoption** and **behavioural change** (the reframe: adoption over timelines)
- **transformation** / **workforce transformation**
- **future-ready** / **future-fit** / **future of work**
- **lasting / sustainable / sustained** ("lasting results," "lasting business value," "sustainable change," "results stick, and scale")
- **resilient / adaptable / agile / agility**
- **measurable / results-driven / drive measurable success**
- **hearts and minds** ("capture the hearts and minds of your workforce")
- **co-create / co-creation** ("co-create a workforce," "our approach blends insight, behavioural science, and co-creation")
- **AI / GenAI / agentic AI** as the consistent urgency driver ("Agentic AI shouldn't be seen as a threat - but as a catalyst")
- **skills / upskilling / reskilling** and **operating model**

**2025-2026 framing note:** the current copy is heavily AI-anchored (GenAI adoption strategy, agentic AI, "Global AI Jobs Barometer," "5 steps to redesign roles and build trust in the AI era"), and leans on PwC's ongoing *Hopes and Fears* Global Workforce Survey for its market-trend stats (e.g. "70% of daily GenAI users expect major job impacts from the technology"), confirming these are live 2025-2026 pages.
